actionEditor.title: Action policy
actionEditor.boundary: Edit scheduling policy only. Saving does not execute an action, command, update or notification. Credentials and execution settings remain read-only. Global manual mode and container eligibility still apply.
actionEditor.actionUnavailable: This exact action is not available in the editor snapshot.
actionEditor.apiUnavailable: This server does not provide the action policy editor API.
actionEditor.orderHelp: Negative and fractional values are allowed. Existing order inheritance can also affect other actions and notifications with the same name.
actionEditor.concurrencyHelp: A positive whole number. Removing the file override restores inherited settings. For Compose, this limits independent projects, not services within one file.
actionEditor.invalidNumber: Enter a finite number. To inherit settings, remove the file override explicitly.
actionEditor.invalidConcurrency: Enter a positive whole number. To inherit settings, remove the file override explicitly.
